phase2.a8.apprenticeship.title: Request a workshop assessment
phase2.a8.apprenticeship.brief: Bring one repair question to the school careers desk. Ask for a supervised visit to the Nabapara repair workshop; no placement or licence is promised.
phase2.a8.study_bridge.title: Book a foundation study adviser meeting
phase2.a8.study_bridge.brief: Bring a recent homework page. Choose one topic to practise with the adviser and ask about foundation study and later adult bridge routes.
phase2.a8.community_practice.title: Ask about a community logistics placement
phase2.a8.community_practice.brief: At the school careers desk, ask to observe a supervised stock-and-delivery planning session. Agree hours that leave school and home commitments possible.
phase2.a8.retake.title: Discuss next year's examination
phase2.a8.retake.brief: Ask the school office about annual retake registration, allowed up to age twenty. You can leave without registering and continue Class XI.
phase2.a8.equipment.title: Apply for a practice-equipment allowance
phase2.a8.equipment.brief: Bring a list of equipment you would use to the school careers desk. Ask about terms and application evidence. The displayed envelope is not money in your wallet.
phase2.a8.licence.title: Request a supervised licence assessment
phase2.a8.licence.brief: Ask the careers adviser to review your hunter credential and explain supervision and eligibility. A tower credential alone does not grant a licence.
phase2.a8.patronage.title: Prepare a portfolio for review
phase2.a8.patronage.brief: Bring a piece of school or independent work. Ask the careers adviser which sponsorship review accepts it and what commitments a sponsor requests.
phase2.a8.public_portfolio.title: Decide whether to share your portfolio
phase2.a8.public_portfolio.brief: Meet the school adviser to review exactly which credentials and work would be public. Keeping the portfolio private remains a complete choice.
phase2.a8.scholarship.title: Request a scholarship interview
phase2.a8.scholarship.brief: Bring your credential portfolio to the school careers desk. Ask about interview dates, study requirements and support terms; an offer is an application opportunity.
phase2.a8.enterprise.title: Book a proposal assessment
phase2.a8.enterprise.brief: Bring a small service or workshop proposal. Ask the careers adviser about a supervised starting-capital review and its obligations; no loan is accepted here.
phase2.a8.strong.title: Make room after a strong result
phase2.a8.strong.brief: Talk with your class teacher after lessons about interviews and the school work you still want to do. You do not have to publish your rank or take a competitive path.
phase2.a8.middle.title: Choose a next step at your own pace
phase2.a8.middle.brief: Bring one tower observation to your class teacher. Compare an apprenticeship enquiry with a study bridge, then keep or change your ordinary school plan.
phase2.a8.poor.title: Ask for a practical next step
phase2.a8.poor.brief: Meet your class teacher after lessons. Choose a workshop enquiry, a foundation study meeting or community logistics practice. There is no remedial punishment and no requirement to fight.
phase2.a8.withdrawn.title: Talk through leaving the tower
phase2.a8.withdrawn.brief: If you want, tell your class teacher what made you stop. Earlier credentials remain on the result. Choose an ordinary school week or an application meeting without replaying the tower.
phase2.a8.deferred.title: Plan a school week without this year's exam
phase2.a8.deferred.brief: Meet the school office after lessons to ask about next year's examination and its age limit, or focus on class work. Deferral does not reserve admission or interrupt school.
phase2.a8.declined.title: Explore a route without the examination
phase2.a8.declined.brief: Ask the careers adviser about workshop apprenticeships and foundation or adult bridge qualifications. Continue Class XI; you do not have to register for another tower attempt.
phase2.a8.school.title: Return to your next school day
phase2.a8.school.brief: Open the school timetable and attend the next scheduled class. The calendar, stream and school closures still govern attendance; the tower result does not cancel lessons.
phase2.a8.study.title: Work on a homework question
phase2.a8.study.brief: Open the study desk at home or in the care home's study room. Choose a brief or ordinary study activity; existing deadlines and activity costs remain in force.
phase2.a8.rest.title: Leave room for rest
phase2.a8.rest.brief: Open the ordinary day planner and choose a rest activity when you want it. You can spend the following week at school and home without pursuing any tower offer.
phase2.a8.title: After the tower
phase2.a8.continuity: Class XI, friendships and life at home continue. These are optional next steps. Reading and planning cost no time.
phase2.a8.pending: A final tower decision is not available yet. Return to your current activity.
phase2.a8.rejected: That next step is unavailable. Refresh your plan or return to school.
phase2.a8.accepted: Opened your next step. A booking exists only when the destination confirms it.
